verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships an official MCP server (bundled in the dg CLI) that lets AI coding tools/agents connect directly to Deepgram's APIs, confirmed both in docs and via a dedicated agentic-tools page. This directly satisfies the story of connecting an agent to Deepgram via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server works reliably in practice, and more detail on which Voice Agent capabilities specifically are exposed through it.
